claims.text: Patient takes amlodipine 5 mg daily, as recorded in a staff note.
Amlodipine was stopped because of ankle swelling; blood pressure is to be reviewed in two weeks.

citations.quote: Amlodipine was stopped because of ankle swelling

open_questions: When was the ankle swelling first recorded, and how did it evolve before amlodipine was stopped? The record does not document this.
Was amlodipine the only antihypertensive tried, and what was the blood pressure control history before it was stopped? The record does not say.
Was the two-week blood pressure review arranged, completed or rescheduled? The record only notes the plan, with no outcome.
Was any alternative antihypertensive started after amlodipine was stopped? The record does not say.
What was the amlodipine start date and were there earlier dose changes? Only the current 5 mg daily dose is recorded.
Which allergies or reactions are recorded? No allergy entries appear in the record.

citation.quote: Amlodipine was stopped because of ankle swelling

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Record shows a stopped antihypertensive with a pending blood pressure review, which carries cardiovascular risk if follow-up is missed.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Confirm the two-week blood pressure review has been scheduled and documented.
